name: Qwen 3.8 Flash Next
description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is Qwen’s experimental open-weight multimodal language model, pairing 125B parameters with just 6B activated for efficient reasoning and generation. With native 262K-token context extensible to 1M, vision support, and an architecture optimized for lower long-context latency, it is built for demanding agentic coding, tool use, visual reasoning, and multimodal automation.
